for(const roundingMode of ['ceil','floor','expand','trunc','halfCeil','halfFloor','halfExpand','halfTrunc','halfEven'])for(const n of [-2.55,-2.5,-2.45,-0.05,-0,0,0.05,2.45,2.5,2.55,'9007199254740993.25']){const f=new Intl.NumberFormat('de-DE',{maximumFractionDigits:1,roundingMode});record(f.format(n));record(JSON.stringify(f.formatToParts(n)));}
for(const options of [{minimumSignificantDigits:3,maximumSignificantDigits:3},{maximumSignificantDigits:2},{maximumSignificantDigits:3,maximumFractionDigits:2,roundingPriority:'morePrecision'},{maximumSignificantDigits:3,maximumFractionDigits:2,roundingPriority:'lessPrecision'},{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2,roundingIncrement:5},{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2,roundingIncrement:25,roundingMode:'halfEven'},{notation:'scientific'},{notation:'engineering'},{notation:'compact'},{notation:'compact',compactDisplay:'long'},{notation:'compact',maximumFractionDigits:1}]){const f=new Intl.NumberFormat('de-DE',options);record(JSON.stringify(f.resolvedOptions()));for(const n of [0,-0,0.001234,1,1.025,1.125,1234,12345,123456,999950,1234567,1e20,NaN,Infinity]){record(f.format(n));record(JSON.stringify(f.formatToParts(n)));}}
